description: The Anthropic branch of the dispatcher, showing the Messages endpoint, its own header names, and where the reply text lives.

steps.description: Enter the Anthropic branch. Throw if no API key is set, then pick the configured model or fall back to the default for Anthropic.

Post to `https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages`. The headers carry the key in `x-api-key` (not `Authorization`), a required `anthropic-version` pin, and `anthropic-dangerous-direct-browser-access` to opt in to calling from a browser.
The body sends the model, `max_tokens`, `temperature`, and a `messages` array holding one user message with the prompt.
Parse the JSON response, with a fallback to raw text, and throw an error when the response is not ok or contains an error field.

Anthropic returns a `content` array of blocks, so the function maps each block to its `text`, joins them, trims, and returns the string. The page notes the reply text is an array of content blocks, not a single string.

title: Anthropic Branch
